name: What is the difference between a gunite and fiberglass pool?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a gunite and fiberglass pool?

acceptedAnswer.text: Gunite pools are custom-built on-site by spraying a concrete mixture over a steel rebar framework, allowing for unlimited design flexibility in shape, size, and depth. They are known for their durability and customizability. Fiberglass pools, conversely, are pre-fabricated shells installed as a single unit. While they offer quicker installation and a smooth, non-porous surface that can reduce chemical use, their shapes and sizes are limited to available molds. Gunite offers more aesthetic freedom, while fiberglass prioritizes speed and lower maintenance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Gunite pools are custom-built on-site with concrete for flexible designs, while fiberglass pools are pre-fabricated shells for quicker installation with limited shapes.
